facts.summary: Phase 2b met primary endpoint, 33% proteinuria cut · Phase 2 · atacicept in IgA nephropathy · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Atacicept met primary endpoint at week 24
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Atacicept met primary endpoint at week 24
evidence.safety: Atacicept was generally well tolerated in IgAN patients, with no reported deaths, low rate (2%) of serious AEs overall, and 1 patient (1%) discontinued atacicept due to AE
evidence.program_discontinued: Atacicept 150 mg dose selected for Phase 3 clinical trial, expected to initiate in 1H 2023
